🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength, but signals are mixed: VXX is in CORRECTION (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) as fear eases near-term, while the SPY/TLT ratio is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) and HYG/LQD is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%). The XLY/XLP ratio is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%), and SPY and XLK remain in RECOVERY, reinforcing a mixed rather than directional backdrop.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress is easing: HYG/LQD is rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%). Fear is easing week-over-week but remains elevated versus a month ago: VXX is falling, in CORRECTION (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%); stocks are recovering versus bonds, with SPY/TLT rising, in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%). The yield-curve indicator is falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -0.50%), while duration preference is also falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -0.34%); TLT is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials and defensives show sustained strength: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), XLP is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%), and XLU is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +5.74%). Tech bounced but remains in RECOVERY: XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%); the XLK/XLF ratio is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%), so style is mixed, with relative weakness in Tech.

5. US vs Global?
SPY is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%); EEM is also in RECOVERY (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%), while FXI is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%). India stands out: INDA is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +7.30%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps hold up better: IWM is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%). Risk appetite remains uneven: ARKK is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) and IBIT is BELOW TREND (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals remain weak: GLD is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%) and SLV is BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%). Copper is also BELOW TREND: CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is rebounding but remains below its monthly level: XLE is in RECOVERY (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%). Natural gas is also in RECOVERY: UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed strength: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), while TLT is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%). Divergence: SPY is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) and XLK is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%), while breadth remains broad at 11/11 positive.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor areas with sustained strength, including Financials: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%). Keep exposure selective around Tech’s bounce: XLK is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%); style remains mixed, not a broad risk-on confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad participation persists, monitor XLF, ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), and XLP, ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%).
BEARISH: If Tech’s rebound falters, watch XLK, in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the rebound holds, monitor XLE, in RECOVERY (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%), and UNG, in RECOVERY (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%).
BEARISH: If weakness persists, watch GLD, BELOW TREND (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%), and CPER, BELOW TREND (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%).

13. Key Levels?
HYG/LQD 0.7484, rising ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%); SPY/TLT 9.5033, rising in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%); XLK/XLF 2.9018, falling BELOW TREND (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%); dollar-strength indicator rising ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive and broad strength, but conflicting risk and cycle signals. Financials show relative strength: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), while style leadership remains mixed. Monitor the Tech recovery and persistent monthly weakness: XLK is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%).
